description:
Dive into the whimsical world of improvisation at our Wednesday Jams!

Whether you’re a novice to theatre, a maverick on stage, or just dipping your toes into the world of unscripted performance, this Jam is designed for everyone. Our facilitators will guide you through a series of engaging improv exercises, help you explore new characters, and set up scenarios that will make your inner wit shine - all on the spot!

description:
Ukulele With Luv is bringing its community jam energy to Bangalore for the very first time! 

Uke Jam: Bangalore is an afternoon built for ukulele lovers of every level, inspired by the same spirit that powers Pune Uke Club back home. Here’s what to expect:

 Open Mic — Got a song you’ve been practicing? Take the stage and share it

 Guided Group Jam — Strum along to pre-decided songs together (beginner players welcome!)

 Special Performances — Hear from Bangalore’s own ukulele community and guest artists

 A room full of fellow players — Meet other uke enthusiasts from the city and beyond

 A relaxed, welcoming vibe — Come solo or bring a friend and soak in a Sunday afternoon of music

Whether you’ve just picked up a ukulele before or you’ve been playing for years, this is a space to learn, perform, and connect.

Spectators are welcome to join the Open Mic portion at a reduced entry price. Open to all ages 10 and above.

Who is Ukulele with Luv?

Organised by Ukulele With Luv, Pune’s most active ukulele teaching initiative. Founded and run by Luv Mahtani, a Pune-based musician, educator, community organiser, and experience curator. Luv is a James Hill Ukulele Initiative certified educator with over nine years of teaching experience. He is also the founder of Pune Uke Club, a grassroots ukulele community built on the belief that the ukulele is for everyone, known for its jams, open mics, and live events celebrating the joy of making music together. Follow 
@ukulelewithluv
 on Instagram to know more.

description:
This Musical Improv Jam is a space to ease into singing, rhythm, and making things up with a bit of melody.

We’ll walk through the basics of finding a beat, building simple rhymes, spotting patterns, and shaping a chorus or catchphrase you can come back to. We’ll do just enough to help you feel grounded and willing to try.

description:
When was the last time you put a jigsaw puzzle together? Puzzles are for everyone! It doesn’t matter if you loved puzzles as a kid, enjoy them now, or want to pick up a new hobby; if you do them solo or with friends and family; whether you like to take your time or prefer to blitz them - Bangalore Puzzle Pals is for you.

Join us to enjoy a relaxed off-screen evening in a social setting while you put together beautiful images, solve puzzles from new and exciting brands, and get a little competitive with some speed puzzling or puzzle chess! You’re also welcome to bring your own puzzles either to solve or sell/swap with others.

Come alone, with a partner, with friends or family! We will have something for everyone. (Under-18s may attend if accompanied by an adult.)

We are Bangalore’s first jigsaw puzzle meetup group, providing a space for puzzle enthusiasts to come together to solve jigsaws, swap and sell their puzzles, and compete in speed puzzling! We meet in-person every Monday and on the occasional weekend.

description:
PowerPoint Roulette is a fast-paced, creative show where improvisers deliver presentations from slides they’ve never seen before. Each performer is faced with slides filled with bizarre graphs, meaningless acronyms, and unexpected themes. With no time to prepare, they must improvise convincing explanations, facts, stories, and insights on the spot.

Serious business pitches, heartfelt eulogies, hard-hitting TED talks, and fanciful conspiracy theories - prepare yourselves for a night ‘official’ fun! The audience gets to join the revelry by asking questions, creating a truly unpredictable night of improvised theatrics.

description:
Made of Dreams: Poetry & Open Mic Evening

For those who dream wildly, feel deeply, and find magic in words.

An intimate evening of poetry, storytelling, open mic and live art, where words are shared and art is created in real time.

 Poetry & stories from Aditi

A solo performance of poems and stories about dreams, ambition, identity, growing up, and finding your way back to yourself.

 Open mic slots

A space for you to get on stage and share a poem, story, thought, song, or anything else you’ve been carrying around in your head.

 Live art created during the evening

Watch an artist turn the words, emotions and energy of the evening into a piece of art — created live, as the night unfolds.

 Prompts and moments to reflect

A few playful and thoughtful prompts to make you pause, look inward, and maybe reconnect with a dream you’ve forgotten about.

A room full of dreamers

Come meet people who feel deeply, create things, question the usual path, and are still figuring out what they want their lives to look like.

An evening to remember what you’re made of.

About the artist:

Aditi Sinha is an entrepreneur, writer and performer who spent six years building a tech company before stepping away to pursue her love for poetry, storytelling and music. She creates Made of Dreams as an evening for dreamers: a little space to slow down, feel deeply, and remember that life can still be magical.

description:
Most people think improvisers are fearless; the truth is they’ve just learnt what to do when they don’t know what to do.

This beginner-friendly introduction to improv is designed for anyone who’s ever worried about saying the wrong thing, running out of ideas, or freezing up in front of others. Through fun games, simple exercises, and guided scene work, you’ll learn how to trust your instincts, embrace uncertainty, and stay present when things don’t go according to plan.

Through the course, we’ll explore some core principles of improvisation, collaborative storytelling, and spontaneous creativity in a supportive, low-stake environment.

No acting or stage experience required. You don’t need to be funny, quick-witted, or confident. You just need a willingness to step on stage and discover that you can handle more than you think.

Schedule:

This course runs over four consecutive days:

Saturday, October 17 - 10:00 AM to 1:00 PM

Sunday, October 18 - 10:00 AM to 1:00 PM

Monday, October 19 - 2:00 PM to 5:00 PM

Tuesday, October 20 - 2:00 PM to 5:00 PM

There’s a special Graduation Show tentatively on Sunday, November 1st, from 11:00AM - 12:30PM. This audience of this show will comprise solely of your friends and family; it will not be open to the public. This is to ensure a supportive audience for you taking to the stage for the first time!

description:
No one sits this one out. Forget the usual trivia night where one smart friend carries the table.

Here, it’s a rapid-fire run of mini games, and every single player is in the hot seat. One minute you’re answering a question, the next you’re racing the clock.

There’s no theme and no warning. Movies, history, science, pop culture, pure chaos: anything can be thrown your way, and the pace never lets up.

Bring your team. Bring your competitive streak. Oh, and leave your friendliness at the door.

About Quiztickles

Run by two friends, Varun and Aayushi, who turn ordinary nights into the ones people won’t stop talking about. From trivia to murder mysteries and beyond, they host live games built for people who like their fun with a little edge.

description:
When do you work on your creative projects—the ones that are just for you?

You walk in. It’s been a long day, probably. You see strangers working, chatting, and sometimes doing nothing. You join a table. Or sit alone. Whatever floats your boat.

You set your space and begin your unfinished project: a piece of writing you’re finishing, crochet, a Lego set, postcards waiting to be written, or sketches that might turn into something new.

Or — you could dive into what we have here: Use the colourful papers, old magazines for collages, and books to inspire you. Use a medium you haven’t tried before.

Bring a friend, or drop in alone after work. Leave with messy hands and a sense of calm and excitement for all the possibilities.

No two 
After Hours
